Our Story
A Little About Me

Hey, I'm the owner of BS Pressure Washing. I started this business because I genuinely love the work and I love seeing the difference it makes for people.

There's something really satisfying about showing up to a property that looks worn down and dirty, and leaving it looking completely brand new. Watching a stained driveway or grimy siding transform in a matter of hours. That never gets old for me.

I started BS Pressure Washing because I wanted to build something real in my community. I'm not here to cut corners or take anyone's money and run. Every single job I do, I treat it like it's my own home. I show up on time, I work hard, and I don't leave until I'm proud of the result.

Medford is my hometown and these are my neighbors. That means everything to me. When you hire BS Pressure Washing, you're not hiring some big faceless company. You're hiring someone who actually cares about doing right by you.

Brock, Owner of BS Pressure Washing

Got Questions?
Frequently Asked Questions
Everything you need to know before booking. Don't see your question? Give us a call!

Yes! We use biodegradable, eco-friendly detergents that are safe for your lawn, plants, and garden. We also take care to rinse surrounding vegetation before and after cleaning to minimize any impact.

We use the client's water supply we do not bring or supply our own water. Please make sure there is an accessible outdoor water spigot available at your property before we arrive.

Not when done correctly. We adjust the pressure based on the surface high pressure for concrete and driveways, and soft wash (low pressure + detergent) for siding, wood decks, and delicate surfaces. We treat every surface with care.

Pricing depends on the size of the area and the type of service. We offer free no-obligation quotes just fill out our contact form or give us a call and we'll get you an accurate estimate fast.

We recommend getting your property pressure washed every 6 months to keep it looking its best and to prevent buildup of mold, algae, and grime. Regular cleaning also protects your surfaces and extends their lifespan.

We serve Medford, Central Point, Jacksonville, Eagle Point, Talent, Phoenix, and surrounding areas in the Rogue Valley. Not sure if we cover your location? Just give us a call and we'll let you know!
